sources.snippet: Whisper is a general-purpose speech recognition model. It is trained on a large dataset of diverse audio and is also a multitasking model that can perform multilingual speech recognition, speech translation, and language identification.

sources.title: GitHub - CRF007/nb-whisper-small-beta
sources.snippet: NB-Whisper Small (beta) This is a public beta of the Norwegian NB-Whisper Small model released by the National Library of Norway. NB-Whisper is a series of models for automatic speech recognition (ASR) and speech translation, building upon the foundation laid by OpenAI's Whisper. All models are trained on 20,000 hours of labeled data.

sources.title: nb-whisper-tiny-verbatim | PromptLayer Models
sources.snippet: What is nb-whisper-tiny-verbatim? nb-whisper-tiny-verbatim is a specialized Norwegian automatic speech recognition (ASR) model designed for verbatim transcription. Built upon OpenAI's Whisper architecture, this model has been fine-tuned with an additional 200 steps to produce lowercase text without punctuation, making it particularly suitable for linguistic analysis and exact transcription needs.
